canvas.title: Launch graphic
canvas.source:
import { Canvas, Column, Heading, Image, Layer, Text, Row } from "@hyper-elements/react";

export default function LaunchCard() {
  return (
    <Canvas width={1200} height={630} style={{ backgroundColor: "#1d1670", fontFamily: "Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif", color: "#ffffff" }}>
      <Layer style={{ width: 1200, height: 630 }}>
        <Image src={{ src: "https://hyperelements.dev/img/orbit-card-bg.png", width: 1200, height: 630 }} alt="" />
        <Row style={{ padding: [64, 40, 64, 80], gap: 40, alignItems: "center", height: 630 }}>
          <Column style={{ width: 480, flex: "none", gap: 22 }}>
            <Row>
              <Text style={{ flex: "none", fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 3, color: "#3b2bd1", backgroundColor: "#ffffff", borderRadius: 999, padding: [9, 18] }}>
                NOW AVAILABLE
              </Text>
            </Row>
            <Heading level={1} style={{ fontSize: 108, lineHeight: 0.95, letterSpacing: -4, color: "#ffffff" }}>
              Orbit 2.0
            </Heading>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 30, lineHeight: 1.25, color: "#d9dcff" }}>Ship every surface from one codebase.</Text>
            <Row style={{ alignItems: "center", gap: 16, padding: [26, 0, 0, 0] }}>
              <Image src={{ src: "https://hyperelements.dev/img/orbit-logo-white.png", width: 252, height: 128 }} alt="Orbit" style={{ width: 110, flex: "none" }} />
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 22, color: "#a5abff" }}>orbit.dev</Text>
            </Row>
          </Column>
          <Image
            src={{ src: "https://hyperelements.dev/img/orbit-app.png", width: 1200, height: 700 }}
            alt="The Orbit 2.0 dashboard"
            style={{ width: 560, borderRadius: 16, border: "6px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18)" }}
          />
        </Row>
      </Layer>
    </Canvas>
  );
}

page.title: Landing page
page.source:
import { Button, Column, Grid, Heading, Image, Menu, Page, Text, Row, Section } from "@hyper-elements/react";

const features = [
  { icon: "◆", title: "Live previews", body: "See every template in every output while you type." },
  { icon: "▲", title: "Typed templates", body: "Props checked by TypeScript before anything ships." },
  { icon: "●", title: "One-click deploys", body: "Push a new version to production in seconds." },
];

export default function LandingPage() {
  return (
    <Page width={1120} title="Orbit: ship every surface" style={{ backgroundColor: "#ffffff", fontFamily: "Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif", color: "#0f172a" }}>
      <Section style={{ padding: [20, 32], border: { bottom: "1px solid #eef0f4" } }}>
        <Row style={{ alignItems: "center", gap: 24 }} stackOnMobile={false}>
          <Image src={{ src: "https://hyperelements.dev/img/orbit-logo.png", width: 252, height: 128 }} alt="Orbit" style={{ width: 84, flex: "none" }} />
          <Menu
            items={[
              { text: "Product", href: "https://example.com/product" },
              { text: "Pricing", href: "https://example.com/pricing" },
              { text: "Docs", href: "https://example.com/docs" },
              { text: "Changelog", href: "https://example.com/changelog" },
            ]}
            separator=" "
            style={{ fontSize: 14, color: "#475569", justifyContent: "center" }}
          />
          <Button href="https://example.com/signup" style={{ backgroundColor: "#0f172a", borderRadius: 999, padding: [10, 18], fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700, flex: "none" }}>
            Get started
          </Button>
        </Row>
      </Section>
      <Section style={{ padding: [72, 32, 40, 32], gap: 22, alignItems: "center", textAlign: "center" }}>
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: "#6d5efc", backgroundColor: "#eeecff", borderRadius: 999, padding: [6, 14] }}>
          New · Orbit 2.0
        </Text>
        <Heading level={1} style={{ fontSize: 60, lineHeight: 1.04, letterSpacing: -2, maxWidth: 760 }} mobile={{ fontSize: 38 }}>
          Ship every surface from one codebase.
        </Heading>
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 19, lineHeight: 1.55, color: "#475569", maxWidth: 600 }}>
          Live previews, typed templates and one-click deploys for the team that owns your product's every pixel.
        </Text>
        <Row style={{ gap: 12, justifyContent: "center" }}>
          <Button href="https://example.com/signup" style={{ backgroundColor: "#6d5efc", borderRadius: 10, padding: [14, 24], fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, flex: "none" }} hover={{ backgroundColor: "#5a4bf0" }}>
            Start for free
          </Button>
          <Button href="https://example.com/demo" style={{ backgroundColor: "#ffffff", color: "#0f172a", border: "1px solid #d7dbe3", borderRadius: 10, padding: [14, 24], fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700, flex: "none" }}>
            Book a demo
          </Button>
        </Row>
      </Section>
      <Section style={{ padding: [8, 32, 56, 32] }}>
        <Image
          src={{ src: "https://hyperelements.dev/img/orbit-app.png", width: 1200, height: 700 }}
          alt="The Orbit 2.0 dashboard"
          style={{ borderRadius: 14, border: "1px solid #e2e8f0" }}
        />
      </Section>
      <Section style={{ backgroundColor: "#f8fafc", padding: [56, 32] }}>
        <Grid columns={3} style={{ gap: 20 }}>
          {features.map((f) => (
            <Column key={f.title} style={{ backgroundColor: "#ffffff", border: "1px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius: 14, padding: 24, gap: 8 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 18, color: "#6d5efc" }}>{f.icon}</Text>
              <Heading level={3} style={{ fontSize: 18 }}>{f.title}</Heading>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 15, lineHeight: 1.55, color: "#64748b" }}>{f.body}</Text>
            </Column>
          ))}
        </Grid>
      </Section>
      <Section style={{ padding: [28, 32] }}>
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#94a3b8", textAlign: "center" }}>© 2026 Orbit Labs · Privacy · Terms</Text>
      </Section>
    </Page>
  );
}

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.description: A weekly digest with a hero image, stories side by side that stack on phones, a reading list and a footer.
newsletter.source:
import { Button, Column, Divider, Email, Heading, Image, Link, List, ListItem, Menu, Text, Row, Section } from "@hyper-elements/react";

const stories = [
  {
    kicker: "DEEP DIVE",
    title: "Why email still runs on tables",
    body: "A short history of the 1999 rendering engine inside your inbox, and what it means for your layout.",
    href: "https://example.com/tables",
  },
  {
    kicker: "TOOLING",
    title: "One template, four outputs",
    body: "The same JSX became an email, a landing page, a PDF and a social card. Here's the code.",
    href: "https://example.com/outputs",
  },
];

export default function Newsletter() {
  return (
    <Email
      previewText="Tables, outputs and five links worth your time"
      style={{ backgroundColor: "#fffbeb", fontFamily: "Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif", color: "#1f2937" }}
    >
      <Image
        src={{ src: "https://hyperelements.dev/img/newsletter-hero.png", width: 1200, height: 500 }}
        alt="The Weekly Signal"
      />
      <Section style={{ padding: [32, 32, 8, 32], gap: 12 }}>
        <Text style={{ fontFamily: "Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif", fontSize: 12, letterSpacing: 2, color: "#b45309" }}>
          ISSUE 142 · NOVEMBER 6
        </Text>
        <Heading level={1} style={{ fontSize: 32, lineHeight: 1.15 }} mobile={{ fontSize: 26 }}>
          The week the inbox caught up
        </Heading>
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 17, lineHeight: 1.6, color: "#4b5563" }}>
          Good morning. This week: why your emails are still tables underneath, and a reading list for the weekend.
        </Text>
      </Section>
      <Section style={{ padding: [16, 32] }}>
        <Row style={{ gap: 24 }}>
          {stories.map((story) => (
            <Column key={story.href} style={{ gap: 8 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontFamily: "Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif", fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: 2, color: "#b45309" }}>
                {story.kicker}
              </Text>
              <Heading level={2} style={{ fontSize: 20, lineHeight: 1.25 }}>
                <Link href={story.href} style={{ color: "#111827", textDecoration: "none" }}>{story.title}</Link>
              </Heading>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 15, lineHeight: 1.55, color: "#4b5563" }}>{story.body}</Text>
            </Column>
          ))}
        </Row>
      </Section>
      <Section style={{ padding: [8, 32, 24, 32], gap: 16 }}>
        <Divider style={{ borderTop: "1px solid #fcd34d" }} />
        <Heading level={3} style={{ fontSize: 18 }}>Five links for the weekend</Heading>
        <List type="number" style={{ gap: 8, fontSize: 15, color: "#374151" }}>
          <ListItem><Link href="https://example.com/1">Dark mode, one color at a time</Link></ListItem>
          <ListItem><Link href="https://example.com/2">The plain-text version nobody writes</Link></ListItem>
          <ListItem><Link href="https://example.com/3">Merge tags across providers</Link></ListItem>
          <ListItem><Link href="https://example.com/4">Printing invoices without a browser</Link></ListItem>
          <ListItem><Link href="https://example.com/5">Let your agent write the template</Link></ListItem>
        </List>
        <Button
          href="https://example.com/archive"
          style={{ backgroundColor: "#111827", borderRadius: 999, padding: [12, 24], fontFamily: "Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif", alignSelf: "start" }}
        >
          Read past issues
        </Button>
      </Section>
      <Section style={{ backgroundColor: "#111827", padding: 32, gap: 12, color: "#d1d5db" }}>
        <Menu
          items={[
            { text: "Archive", href: "https://example.com/archive" },
            { text: "Sponsor", href: "https://example.com/sponsor" },
            { text: "Unsubscribe", href: "https://example.com/unsubscribe" },
          ]}
          separator="/"
          style={{ fontFamily: "Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif", fontSize: 13, color: "#f9fafb", separatorColor: "#6b7280", justifyContent: "start" }}
        />
        <Text style={{ fontFamily: "Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif", fontSize: 12, color: "#9ca3af" }}>
          The Weekly Signal is written by people who have opened too many emails in Outlook.
        </Text>
      </Section>
    </Email>
  );
}
